kicker: Neuron steering on a small model

scenes.headline: How one neuron gets found and steered
scenes.sub: Find it, scale the push, measure the damage
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Kevel! One hidden unit inside a language model can change what the whole model writes. Here is how you find one, and how hard to push.

scenes.text: A neuron writes one fixed direction into the residual stream. Steering adds a dose of it, scaled by the size of the stream itself.
scenes.mark: scaled by the size of the stream itself
scenes.say: A neuron writes one fixed direction into the residual stream. Steering just adds a dose of that direction, scaled by how big the stream is.

scenes.title: From two prompt sets to one push

steps.say: Run two sets of prompts through the model and record every neuron's activation.
Rank the neurons by how differently they fire on the two sets.
Pick one. Its column in the down projection is the direction it writes.
Scale that column by a dose, and add it to the residual stream at every position.

scenes.text: dose x median resid norm / column norm
scenes.title: The size of the push

parts.say: The dose is a fraction of the stream.

parts.note: How big the stream is at this layer
parts.say: Multiply by the median norm of the stream leaving that layer, which grows with depth.

parts.note: Converts the push into an activation
parts.say: Divide by the column's own length, to get the shift in the neuron's activation.

left.title: The detector
left.say: A detector fires when the text is French, and a contrast ranking finds it easily.

right.title: The writer
items: Adds its column to the stream
right.say: A writer adds its column to the stream and changes what comes next. Only some detectors are writers.

scenes.label: Top ranked neurons that changed the output language
scenes.say: Of the ten top ranked neurons, two changed the language of the continuation. None of ten random ones did.

scenes.label: jump in held-out perplexity between a dose of 0.1 and 0.15
scenes.say: The window is narrow. Between a dose of point one and point one five, perplexity jumps twenty two fold, and the text turns French.

scenes.text: Detecting French is reading. Steering is writing, and the dose scale decides whether the text survives.
scenes.mark: the dose scale decides whether the text survives
scenes.say: Detecting French is reading. Steering is writing, and the dose scale decides whether the text survives.

scenes.say: A neuron writes one column direction, the dose is a fraction of the stream, and a detector is not always a writer.
